diagnosis.root_cause: Release convergence is blocked by two integration defects and one unproven product route: Escape is bound to both pause and context_back, the preserved cemetery exposes an empty west-perimeter void, and the ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper run/result path has only been demonstrated through a diagnostic fixture rather than uninterrupted play.

stop_conditions: Stop after focused candidate edits and source/resource checks; host/tester owns runtime replay, screenshots, formal gap verdicts, and issue closure.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different integration strategy: make InputMap ownership unambiguous, repair authoritative director/lifecycle transitions, and add one outer world datum with additive collision and anchors around the preserved map instead of repeating transform tuning or replacing authored content.

code: Run focused project/script checks for InputMap uniqueness, wave-director progression 1→5, Bellkeeper/result transitions, XP/draft transaction ordering, build identity, and Retry reset isolation.
Validate scene/resource parsing and preserved host_godot_boot and native_godot_project checks; inspect editor/runtime logs for input, lifecycle, collision, missing-resource, and UI errors.
runtime: Host/tester serially probes pause/context_back, spawn-to-objective movement, ordinary five-wave play, Bellkeeper defeat, Result receipt, upgrade selection, and Retry; capture runtime_state digests before and after each transition with requested/resolved/reset-isolation receipts for any setup hooks.

Recapture west, north, east, and south perimeter outward views plus spawn, critical route, and central-landmark approach/departure views; verify external dressing is non-playable and collision/visibility remain coherent under ordinary movement.
Run all three release-convergence formal checks and preserved base checks; tester owns verdicts and issue-ledger closure.
visual: Capture shipped gameplay, upgrade-draft, Bellkeeper, Result, and Retry-start screenshots at the acceptance resolution.

Inspect the choice page for icon/silhouette hierarchy, current-to-new deltas, no placeholder CURRENT values, restrained copy, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states; verify the repaired perimeter has cemetery depth with no empty void and the landmark remains legible.

done_when: Escape is assigned to exactly one pause/context owner; context_back remains a separate unambiguous action and no duplicate Escape event remains in the shipped InputMap.
Press, hold, and release probes pause and resume exactly once and context_back works independently in title, active, pause, and result contexts without runtime input errors.

Authoritative director state advances through waves 1–5, performs the Bellkeeper transition and defeat resolution, and emits a terminal result transition from normal play rather than a diagnostic fixture.
